in_hebrew.name: מורגנית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'mor' meaning 'bitterness' and 'yam' meaning 'sea', symbolizing the bitterness of life or the sea of troubles.

in_greek.name: Μοργάννη
in_greek.long_meaning: A variation of the Greek name 'Maria' with the addition of 'annē' meaning 'grace' or 'favor', creating a name meaning 'Mary of the Sea' or 'Mary of Grace'.

in_latin.name: Morgana
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin derivative of the Greek name 'Morgánnē', which means 'Mary of the Sea'. This name gained popularity in medieval Europe and was often associated with legends of enchantment and sorcery.
